description: Polling-friendly status check for one of your jobs: a picture task (generate_image), a video (the task_id or job_id from generate_video) or an audio take (a generation_id or a rendering request_id). Returns a slim shape with `kind`, `status`, `progressPct`, and `eta` (plus the links once a video or take is finished) so you can poll without refetching the full payload.

taskId.description: The id to check: a picture task id, a video task_id or job_id, or an audio generation_id or request_id.

name: check_job_status
title: Check Job Status
